This test verifies that dotted text without a scheme is only linkified
for go.dev and golang.org (golang/go#70033).

-- go.mod --
module example.com

go 1.18
-- a/a.go --
package a //@documentlink(links)

var _ = []string{
	"p.name is %q",
	"go.dev is my favorite site!",
	"see pkg.go.dev/fmt and golang.org/x/tools",
	"https://p.name is not a real site!",
}

// See example.com/doc or tip.golang.org/doc.
-- @links --
a/a.go:5:3-9 https://go.dev
a/a.go:6:7-21 https://pkg.go.dev/fmt
a/a.go:6:26-44 https://golang.org/x/tools
a/a.go:7:3-17 https://p.name
a/a.go:10:27-45 https://tip.golang.org/doc
